errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос показва категориите на възприятие
errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart. The categories are listed on the vertical axis, and the values are represented by the length of the bars along the horizontal dimension.

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос показва процентното разпределение на всяка категория
errors.evidence: In this horizontal bar chart, the vertical axis lists the categories, not the percentage distribution. The lengths of the horizontal bars represent the values.
The chart displays numerical values (e.g., '3,0', '15,2') without an explicit percentage sign (%). Adding the '%' is an interpretation of the units, which are not stated on the chart.
The chart does not have a separate legend. The categories are labeled directly on the vertical axis.
